## Evidence reliability

<div id="theme-evidence-reliability"></div>

### Audit

<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="gemini-grounding-failure-review" data-themes="evidence-reliability responses-references" href="gemini-grounding-failure-review.qmd">
<span>Mixed · Iterate</span>
<strong>Gemini grounding failure review</strong>
<span>Grounding materially helped many true failures but did not provide a reliable blanket cure.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Develop a two-pass disagreement trigger rather than grounding every request.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="openai-luna-pointwise-production-audit" data-themes="evidence-reliability responses-references" href="openai-luna-pointwise-production-audit.qmd">
<span>Positive · Adopt</span>
<strong>OpenAI Luna pointwise production audit</strong>
<span>The 182,764-record artifact is ready for automated use with supported defined as correct or partial, subject to the supplied-Gemini-evidence boundary.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Use the compact supported label in downstream experiments; retain the five-way verdict and explanation for debugging and preserve the audited artifact unchanged. This is an artifact-use decision, not a ranking-system promotion.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="sparse-failure-analogue-diagnosis" data-themes="evidence-reliability query-only-routing candidate-evidence" href="sparse-failure-analogue-diagnosis.qmd">
<span>Negative · Reject</span>
<strong>Sparse-failure analogue diagnosis</strong>
<span>Query analogues rarely identify the official positive: only 11 of 75 had strong or corroborated pre-qrel evidence, and 54 of 75 had no top-ten positive from either promoted component.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Do not treat ordinary query-neighbor transfer or another static fusion weight as the missing ranking signal; test stronger response-evidence reranking instead.</span>
</a>

### Data quality

<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="grounded-data-quality-audit" data-themes="evidence-reliability responses-references" href="grounded-data-quality-audit.qmd">
<span>Mixed · Iterate</span>
<strong>Grounded reference data-quality audit</strong>
<span>The corpus is structurally complete, but uncertain and non-Search records require stratified source-level review.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Adjudicate uncertain records and a stratified non-Search sample before treating references as validated ground truth.</span>
</a>

## Query-only routing

<div id="theme-query-only-routing"></div>

### Ranking experiment

<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="dense-query-knn" data-themes="query-only-routing" href="dense-query-knn.qmd">
<span>Positive · Retain control</span>
<strong>Dense query nearest-neighbor retrieval</strong>
<span>Dense retrieval established the stable query-only control; parameter variants remain diagnostic.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Retain dense_nested as the frozen query-only control.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="query-cluster-aggregation" data-themes="query-only-routing evidence-reliability" href="query-cluster-aggregation.qmd">
<span>Mixed · Reject</span>
<strong>Query-cluster aggregation</strong>
<span>The local prior was negative and preflight variants remained diagnostic.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Do not replace dense retrieval with the tested cluster aggregations.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="query-controls" data-themes="query-only-routing" href="query-controls.qmd">

## Responses and references

<div id="theme-responses-references"></div>

### Audit

<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="e5-raw-response-refinement" data-themes="responses-references evidence-reliability" href="e5-raw-response-refinement.qmd">
<span>Mixed · Informational</span>
<strong>E5 raw-response refinement</strong>
<span>The refinement provides completed diagnostic evidence but does not create a comparable registered ranking system.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> The receipt&#x27;s advance gate means the bounded development follow-up passed its prespecified checks; the Hub decision remains informational because this is not a registered or promoted run.</span>
</a>

### Ranking experiment

<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="pointwise-ranking-phase0" data-themes="responses-references evidence-reliability" href="pointwise-ranking-phase0.qmd">
<span>Negative · Stop</span>
<strong>Pointwise response-quality ranking Phase 0</strong>
<span>Audited pointwise judgments did not produce rankings that agreed well enough with organizer qrels and did not improve the frozen dense control.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Stop pairwise work because the frozen effectiveness gate failed despite sufficient zero-call selector capacity.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="response-retrieval" data-themes="responses-references" href="response-retrieval.qmd">
<span>Negative · Reject</span>
<strong>Lexical response retrieval</strong>
<span>Direct lexical response retrieval underperformed the established dense control.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Reject direct lexical response retrieval as the primary ranking path.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="response-volume-normalization" data-themes="responses-references" href="response-volume-normalization.qmd">
<span>Negative · Reject</span>
<strong>Response-volume normalization</strong>
<span>The normalized response system remained below the established control.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Do not pursue response-volume normalization as a standalone repair.</span>
</a>
<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="source-query-first" data-themes="responses-references evidence-reliability" href="source-query-first.qmd">
<span>Negative · Stop</span>
<strong>Source-query-first response evidence</strong>
<span>The evaluated source-alignment systems did not beat the established control; three constructed variants remain unscored.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Stop this path in its current form and retain unscored constructions as non-results.</span>
</a>

### Reference review

<a class="hub-study-row" data-study-id="four-model-reference-review" data-themes="responses-references evidence-reliability" href="four-model-reference-review.qmd">
<span>Positive · Adopt</span>
<strong>Four-model reference-answer review</strong>
<span>Gemini was the strongest reviewed default, with a material advantage on the purposive sample.</span>
<span class="hub-next-action"><strong>Practical decision</strong> Use Gemini as the default reference generator while retaining Perplexity evidence and escalation.</span>
